name: Combined Force Air Component Commander (CFACC)
responsibilities: Plans, tasks, and controls air operations for the joint/combined force
authorities: Air component commander authority over assigned/attached air forces

name: Director of Mobility Forces (DIRMOBFOR)
responsibilities: Acts as air mobility functional advisor to the air component commander

doctrineSource.note: c2NodeId corrected 2026-09-05 from the generic aoc-tasking-node placeholder to the Air Mobility Division (AMD), which this source identifies as the doctrinal home for mobility tasking and coordination with the 618 AOC/TACC.

name: Combat Operations Division (COD) Chief / Chief of Combat Operations (CCO)
responsibilities: Executes the current ATO/ATONEWS and ACO during the 24-hour execution period

doctrineSource.note: Corrected 2026-09-05: this role was previously (incorrectly) described as building/publishing the ATO. Per this primary source, COD executes the ATO that Combat Plans Division (CPD) builds — see the new combat-plans-division-chief role.

name: Combat Plans Division (CPD) Chief
responsibilities: Responsible for near-term AOC planning (within 48 hours prior to ATO execution)
Builds and publishes the Air Tasking Order (ATO)/ATONEWS, Airspace Control Order (ACO), Airspace Control Plan (ACP), Joint Integrated Prioritized Target List (JIPTL), and SPINS

name: Mission Commander
responsibilities: Overall mission execution and decision authority for the tasked sortie

doctrineSource.note: Generic mission-commander concept; not tied to a specific numbered instruction in this dataset.

name: Aircraft Commander
responsibilities: Pilot in command of the tasked C-17

name: Copilot
responsibilities: Assists the Aircraft Commander in flight operations

name: Loadmaster
responsibilities: Rigs and releases Container Delivery System (CDS) bundles during airdrop
